## Text Embedding 3 Large API

Text Embedding 3 Large is an embedding model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `text-embedding-3-large`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

### Text Embedding 3 Large API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text-embedding-3-large` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.1625 / 1M tok |

### Text Embedding 3 Large specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | OpenAI |
| Released | Apr 17, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Dimensions | 3,072 |
| Max input | 8K tokens |

### How to use the Text Embedding 3 Large API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings` with `"model": "text-embedding-3-large"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "text-embedding-3-large",
    "input": "Private AI for everyone."
  }'
```
